fca9ace10ec4a35fcb24b7a633a893d4a2ea951a.why: The finding of a new collection of whitish material suspended anterior to the optic disc, forming a pocket in the posterior vitreous, suggests a neoplastic or infiltrative process rather than a vascular occlusive disorder.

fd86de72877a038dfcb53c7eb966400813347b3d.why: The finding of a normal lumbar puncture result argues against inflammatory conditions, which often show abnormalities in cerebrospinal fluid analysis.
